title: NVIDIA Expands Open Source Commitment With OpenShell Donation and New AI Infrastructure
summary: NVIDIA宣布把用于Agent安全与治理的OpenShell运行时贡献给CNCF，并参与Google主导的Agent Substrate；同场公布NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine、Recipes和Snapshot等DSX组件。此次动作把Agent运行约束和GPU集群运维放进云原生生态。CNC
investorNote: CNCF Sandbox接纳只代表项目进入社区治理起点，不能据此推断已成为行业标准；应观察其他云厂、Agent平台是否采用和共同维护。

fact.subject: NVIDIA
fact.object: OpenShell Agent运行时并发布DSX组件

evidence.quote: NVIDIA is contributing NVIDIA OpenShell , an open source runtime for securing and governing autonomous agents, to the Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF), a nonprofit that is part of the Linux Foundation and the host of KubeCon.
Additionally, NVIDIA announced new components of the NVIDIA DSX AI Factory Platform : NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine , NVIDIA Kubernetes Recipes and NVIDIA Snapshot .
NVIDIA is also contributing to Agent Substrate , an open source Google-led framework for operating long-running agent workloads at scale on Kubernetes that has been accepted into the CNCF Sandbox.

displayTitle: NVIDIA将OpenShell捐给CNCF，扩展Agent与GPU集群底座
narrative: NVIDIA宣布把用于Agent安全与治理的OpenShell运行时贡献给CNCF，并参与Google主导的Agent Substrate；同场公布NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine、Recipes和Snapshot等DSX组件。此次动作把Agent运行约束和GPU集群运维放进云原生生态。CNCF Sandbox接纳只代表项目进入社区治理起点，不能据此推断已成为行业标准；应观察其他云厂、Agent平台是否采用和共同维护。
